checks.criterion: Sky Ranch phase execution and lot monetization
checks.evidence: Lot sales revenue increased 19% year over year to $3.006 million from $2.526 million; management expects approximately $14.8 million in milestone and finished-lot payments over the next 12 months.

checks.criterion: Lot deliveries paced to builder absorption
checks.evidence: Management expects to complete approximately 159 Phase 2E lots in fiscal 2027, explicitly stating they will be paced to match builder absorption.

checks.criterion: Phase 2D or 2E completion slips by two or more quarters versus prior release
checks.evidence: The current release says Phase 2D is expected to be substantially complete by the end of fiscal 2026 and approximately 159 Phase 2E lots are expected in fiscal 2027, but the prior release timing needed to measure a two-quarter slip is not provided.

checks.criterion: Taps sold stall for two consecutive quarters while Arapahoe County single-family permits decline more than 25% year over year
checks.evidence: Current-quarter tap sales increased to 66 water taps from 40 and 48 wastewater taps from 40; however, two consecutive quarters of tap data and Arapahoe County permit data are not provided.

checks.criterion: Water segment has non-housing demand from oil and gas operators
checks.evidence: Water and wastewater revenue increased 119% year over year to $4.659 million from $2.129 million, water deliveries increased to 631 acre-feet from 76 acre-feet, and management expects continued oil and gas water demand through the remainder of 2026.

checks.criterion: Water and wastewater revenue declines year over year for two quarters as oil and gas demand fades
checks.evidence: Current-quarter water and wastewater revenue increased 119% year over year to $4.659 million; management also states it expects continued oil and gas water sales demand through the remainder of 2026.

checks.criterion: Single-family rental portfolio adds recurring revenue
checks.evidence: Single-family rental revenue increased 76% year over year to $231 thousand from $131 thousand, and management expects the majority of 23 additional contracted units to be available for rent in calendar 2026.

checks.criterion: Equity raise or new debt to fund development beyond existing facilities
checks.evidence: The reported KPIs and guidance contain no disclosure of an equity raise or new debt to fund development beyond existing facilities.

checks.criterion: Phase 2E builder contracts are signed for all builders
checks.evidence: The report provides a Phase 2E expectation of approximately 159 lots in fiscal 2027 but does not provide an update on whether contracts are signed for all builders.

data.summary: Reported results support the thesis: water and wastewater activity, tap sales, lot sales, and rental revenue all increased year over year. No kill criterion is demonstrated, although Phase 2 timing versus the prior release, county permit trends, and financing actions cannot be fully tested from the supplied data.
